review_method: Every listed actual PNG viewed individually at original detail. Read-only visual review; no device or repository changes.
result: No new intrinsic text truncation or layout overlap observed in the visible flow captures.

visible_stages.observation: Creation information form shows activity name, optional location, candidate dates, daily range, full time zone, optional suggestions and next-step availability CTA; no timetable preview.

Own availability draft shows two selected half-hour cells, zero submitted responders, one-day/one-hour unsent summary, submit-and-share action and final-selection entry. Date/status/time zone are readable in metadata.
Share panel is visible over the submitted timetable with one responder. App-friend card, web-link sharing and copy-link actions are distinct and readable.
Received chat plan card shows activity title, availability-needed status and explicit fill-my-availability action.
Participants sheet shows two submitted responses, separate people rows, and explicit explanation that availability does not constitute attendance confirmation.

Final-selection view retains gray collection status in date metadata, distinct legends and clear selected next-day midnight cells. Footer visibly summarizes the cross-day 23:00–01:00 interval over two dates as two hours and offers invitation-list review.
Received chat invitation card shows full cross-day start/end text across two lines, pending-confirmation status and view-invitation action.

Accepted invitation view retains title-area awaiting-formal-send status and location. Two dated tables visibly highlight 23:00–24:00 and 00:00–01:00. Two-of-two confirmation progress and accepted/waiting-for-owner copy are readable.
Calendar search visibly returns the activity with its location and start at 23:00 on the expected first date. Search result is above the keyboard and readable.

limitations: The final Calendar screenshot displays the event start only; it does not visually establish the exact end timestamp.
These nine PNGs do not show two distinct actors Calendar screens or the owner final-send confirmation. API and test assertions are separate evidence for those outcomes.
Screenshots show selected outcomes, not continuous gestures or network ordering. Tap/cancel/drag correctness and delivery chronology are independently established by the parent test run.
The system AssistiveTouch floating control partly overlaps some noncritical right-side screenshot regions and is separate from App layout.
This complete-flow image set uses normal Chinese typography; German system-maximum layout was reviewed separately in the focused ten-image set.
